free_tier.stated: No free plan is published; the cheapest paid plan is USD 25.20/year for the KVM VPS Starter in Chicago with coupon 10THVPS: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, 250 GB Bandwidth, 1 IPv4. KVM VPS 1 is USD 50.40/year for '2 vCPU2 GB RAM20 GB SSD500 GB Bandwidth1 IPv4'; KVM VPS 2 is USD 86.40/year for '3 vCPU4 GB RAM40 GB SSD1 TB Bandwidth1 IPv4'. The same sale prices the Budget XS Plan at USD 2.40/year with 1 GB SSD and 50 GB Bandwidth and the Premium XS Plan at USD 4.32/year with 1 GB NVMe SSD and 50 GB Bandwidth. All coupons are recurring for as long as you renew annually, and all discounts are recurring and apply to annual plans only.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object
per_object_cap.notes: The primary constraint is the virtual machine hardware specification.

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine or an account, not stored bytes
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process, not a stored object

egress.terms: 250 GB a month on the Starter VPS, 500 GB on VPS 1 and 1 TB on VPS 2; no overage price and no post-allowance throttle stated

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: the vendor sells cPanel, DirectAdmin and WHMCS licences alongside the plans and names a Blesta owned licence in the same sale; no API or CLI is documented for the VPS line on either page read
chaining: USD 25.20/year is USD 2.10/month for a 1 GB machine with 250 GB of monthly transfer, which is the cheapest annual VPS among evaluated providers, and the same invoice can carry a mailbox and a small site; 250 GB a month is too little for a crawler, so the job it fits is a cron box, a monitor or a jump host.

limits.value: 250 GB a month on the Starter VPS is the smallest allowance among evaluated providers and the one that binds first by a wide margin: it is about 0.77 Mbit/s sustained, so the counter is the wall and the port is irrelevant. The shared plans carry 50 GB to 200 GB a month. No overage price and no post-allowance throttle are stated.
